fullPassage: The rise in inequality is not the only cause for economic concern. Research by economist George Akerlof on the economics of identity has highlighted the importance of considering how people perceive themselves. In the standard economic model, the only point of working is to earn income to consume. But the economics of identity reminds us that many people's identity is centred around what they produce rather than what they consume. We are more likely to ask someone we've just met 'What do you do?' than 'What do you buy?' So when the twin forces of technology and trade have taken away factory jobs in advanced nations, it's cold comfort to tell the struggling middle class that televisions are getting cheaper. The rise of populist politicians is partly a backlash against the loss of secure working-class jobs, and a reminder of the importance of low unemployment to a stable society.

questions.passage: The rise in inequality is not the only cause for economic concern. Research by economist George Akerlof on the economics of identity has highlighted the importance of considering how people perceive themselves. In the standard economic model, the only point of working is to earn income to consume. But the economics of identity reminds us that many people's identity is centred around what <u>they</u> produce rather than what they consume. We are more likely to ask someone we've just met 'What do you do?' than 'What do you buy?' So when the twin forces of technology and trade have taken away factory jobs in advanced nations, it's cold comfort to tell the struggling middle class that televisions are getting cheaper. The rise of populist politicians is partly a backlash against the loss of secure working-class jobs, and a reminder of the importance of low unemployment to a stable society.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 they가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: they = many people(많은 사람들): 많은 사람들의 정체성이 그들이 생산하는 것에 중심을 둔다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 많은 사람들: 바로 앞의 'many people's identity'에서 many people을 받는 대명사.
❌ ① 경제학자들: 경제학자는 George Akerlof만 언급.
❌ ③ 정치인들: 정치인은 뒤에 등장.
❌ ④ 중산층: 중산층은 뒤에 등장.
det.tip: 대명사의 선행사 = 가장 가까운 복수 명사
